title: Lease renewal: extending possession without re-acquiring it
note: Renewal lets a lease be sized for the common case instead of the worst one, and it is also the single change most able to make a lease stop meaning anything. Every mutation here is one of the ways that happens: renewing what has lapsed, renewing what you do not hold, renewing without limit, or letting the record decide how long a renewal lasts.

mutations.name: L1_a_lapsed_lease_can_be_renewed
mutations.rationale: renewal becomes re-acquisition: reconcile may already have given the work to somebody else, and the old holder takes it back without the job record showing anything unusual

mutations.name: L2_anyone_may_renew_someone_elses_lease
mutations.rationale: ownership becomes something the record asserts about itself, which is the write-path-only defect the replay checks exist to close

mutations.name: L3_a_stale_lease_id_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a worker back from the dead has the same NAME as the live holder; the lease id is the only thing that tells them apart

mutations.name: L4_renewal_is_unbounded
mutations.rationale: a worker holds the job forever by asking often enough, which is the same as having no lease at all

mutations.name: L5_the_record_names_its_own_expiry
mutations.find:
new_end = ev.seq + seqs
        if new_end <= cur.lease_expires_after_seq:
mutations.replace:
new_end = p.get("lease_expires_after_seq", ev.seq + seqs)
        if False:
mutations.rationale: a forged renewal names any expiry it likes, the same shape as a capability naming its own issued_seq

mutations.name: L6_a_renewal_applies_to_a_job_that_is_not_dispatched
mutations.rationale: a queued or finished job acquires a lease deadline, so lease_is_live starts answering about work nobody is doing

mutations.name: L7_a_requeued_job_keeps_its_renewal_count
mutations.rationale: one worker's extensions limit the next worker's, for reasons belonging to a lease that no longer exists -- and dispatch's own reset does not cover it, because _apply_edge silently drops fields it does not name

mutations.name: L8_the_second_reader_accepts_a_lapsed_renewal
mutations.find: if not isinstance(end, int) or ev.seq > end:
mutations.rationale: the independent reader agrees with a renewal the scheduler refuses, so a divergence report says the projections match

mutations.name: L9_the_second_reader_lets_anyone_renew
mutations.find:
if cur.get("lease_holder") != ev.actor:
        _note(out, ev, f"{ev.actor!r} renews a lease held by "
mutations.replace:
if False:
        _note(out, ev, f"{ev.actor!r} renews a lease held by "
mutations.rationale: same defect, reached through the reader that exists to notice it

mutations.name: L10_the_second_reader_reads_the_expiry_off_the_record

mutations.replace:
new_end = p.get("lease_expires_after_seq", ev.seq + seqs)

mutations.rationale: two readers that both trust the payload agree with each other and with the forgery

mutations.name: L11_the_second_reader_keeps_the_lease_after_a_requeue
mutations.rationale: the two readers disagree after any requeue, which is a divergence rather than a defence
